blocks.en: We can also show that for compact operators on a Hilbert space the converse of Theorem~\ref{thm:norm-limit-of-compact-operators} is true.
blocks.zh: 还可以证明, 对于 Hilbert 空间上的紧算子, Theorem~\ref{thm:norm-limit-of-compact-operators} 的逆命题成立.

blocks.en: Theorem~\ref{thm:compact-hilbert-finite-rank-approximation} does not hold for general Banach spaces. On the other hand, we do not have to restrict the image space to be a Hilbert space. All we have actually used is the existence of finite-dimensional projections which converge strongly to the identity. Such projections actually exist in most of the Banach spaces which are important in applications.
blocks.zh: Theorem~\ref{thm:compact-hilbert-finite-rank-approximation} 对一般 Banach 空间不成立. 另一方面, 也不必将像空间限制为 Hilbert 空间. 实际使用的只是存在强收敛到恒等映射的有限维投影. 在应用中重要的大多数 Banach 空间里, 这样的投影确实存在.

blocks.en: The following result can be shown for general Banach spaces $X$ and $Y$.
blocks.zh: 对于一般 Banach 空间 $X$ 和 $Y$, 可以证明以下结果.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $A\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$ be compact. Then $A^\times$ is compact.
blocks.zh: 设 $A\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$ 为紧算子. 那么 $A^\times$ 为紧算子.
blocks.label: thm:compact-operator-adjoint-compact

blocks.en: We ask the reader to prove this in the special case where $X$ and $Y$ are Hilbert spaces (Problem~\ref{ex:compact-adjoint-hilbert-proof}).
